sn48.71-82:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā- -evam eva kho bhikkhu pañcindriyāni bhāvento-nibbānapabbhāro- kathaṃ ca- -nibbānapabbhāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhindriyam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || viriyindriyaṃ || satindriyaṃ || samādhindriyaṃ || paññindriyam bhāveti viveka nissitaṃ- -vossaggapariṇāmim || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu- -nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ti || || Yathā Maggasaṃyutte evam bhavati Indriyasaṃyutte || ||
sn48.71-82:2.0: [Uddānaṃ] Chā pācinato ninnā chā ninnā samuddato || dve ca Gaṅgā dasā honti vaggo tena pavuccatī ti || ||
